_about: Public-domain Francis Nathan Peloubet (1831-1920), Congregational minister and author of the Select Notes on the International Sunday School Lessons, for the Word Hoard: Lord, Increase our Faith, Select Notes for 1877, 1880, 1900 and 1901, Suggestive Illustrations on Matthew, John and Acts, the Teachers' Commentaries on Matthew and Acts, and The Front Line of the Sunday School Movement. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 119 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
